entryWidth.Name: Initial journal width
entryWidth.Hint: Width (px) a journal opens with when its sidebar is collapsed. If it opens expanded, the sidebar width is added. You can still resize the window freely afterwards.

sidebarWidth.Name: Sidebar width
sidebarWidth.Hint: Width (px) of the page sidebar when expanded. Foundry's default is 300.

startCollapsed.Name: Open with collapsed sidebar
startCollapsed.Hint: When enabled, journals open with the page sidebar collapsed.

pageWidth.Name: Initial standalone page width
pageWidth.Hint: Width (px) a journal page opens with in its own window (e.g. when editing it). Foundry's default is 600.

minWidth.Name: Minimum journal width
minWidth.Hint: Minimum width (px) a journal can be resized to. Foundry's default is 680.
